name: Allegheny County Democratic Committee
lean_basis: Official county party organization of the Democratic Party in Allegheny County. Its voter guide says it does not take positions on ballot questions.

name: Republican Committee of Allegheny County
lean_basis: Official county party organization of the Republican Party in Allegheny County. Its own website and 2026 candidate slate were not found; its ballot-question position comes from a party email quoted by WESA (Oct. 12, 2026).

name: Allegheny-Fayette Central Labor Council (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: Labor council with no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating. Its About page (https://paaflcio.org/alleghenyco/about-us) says it "represents the collective interest of its affiliated unions and of the working people of Allegheny County" and works "to advocate for social and economic justice."

name: Steel City Stonewall Democrats
lean_basis: Pittsburgh's LGBTQ Democratic club. Its stated mission (https://www.steel-city.org/) is to "advance equal rights for all people, regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity or expression" and to "help elect qualified Democratic candidates" who support LGBT equal rights.

name: ChamberPAC (Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry)
lean_basis: Political action committee of a statewide chamber of commerce; no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating. Describes itself as "the political arm of the PA Chamber in support of pro-jobs, pro-growth candidates" (https://www.pachamber.org/advocacy/chamber_pac/). Endorses only in state legislative races.

name: LifePAC (Western Pennsylvania)
lean_basis: Anti-abortion political action committee in Western Pennsylvania, founded in 1980; no AllSides or Ad Fontes rating. Its stated aim, as quoted by WESA (Apr. 28, 2026), is to "identify and support candidates for public office who are dedicated to the sanctity of human life." A separate group from the Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation. Its own website and 2026 list were not found.
